findings.summary: Advanced-filter navigations preserve stale work-expansion title query state.
findings.consequence: When a user expands a work in Works mode and then changes an advanced filter, the results can collapse because the selected work is no longer present while the URL still contains the old `title`. Sharing or later restoring that URL can unexpectedly reopen an obsolete work expansion once the title appears again.
findings.evidence: `advancedQueryTarget` builds the next route from `queryFromLiveAdvancedControls()` and deletes only `sida` before replacing the edited advanced key. That source query starts from the full live `route.query`, so `title` survives advanced field, facet, and chronology commits. In contrast, the main request path (`queryFor`), source-download toggle, and imprint-year target path explicitly clear `title` when changing result state.
findings.recommendation: Delete `query.title` in `advancedQueryTarget` before returning the target, matching the existing behavior for other result-changing navigations, unless a future product rule explicitly wants advanced filters to preserve an expanded work.
